worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.summary: Tumble into the target and pass out the far side on the momentum; with nothing in your hands the tumble is doubled. The faster you roll, the harder it is to react to.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.use.1: Roll past the target to reposition
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.use.2: A plain Flying strike while carrying a heavy item
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.description: The tumble deals about %1$s Flying contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; while you hold no item it is doubled, and the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
Roll up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick, then pass about %3$s blocks beyond the target.
A landed hit shoves the target about %1$s blocks along the tumble.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.sweep.on: Long sweep on: a longer lunge and pass-through, but the blow is x0.9 and recovery is 3 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.sweep.off: Long sweep off (tight tumble): the blow is x1.1 and recovery is faster, with a shorter lunge and pass-through.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.growth.0: At level %1$s, Acrobatics power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.acrobatics.growth.1: At level %1$s, Acrobatics power rises to %2$s and the lunge to %3$s.
On: lunge and pass-through about x1.3, but the blow is x0.9 and recovery 3 ticks longer. Off: a tight tumble for x1.1 power and a faster recovery, with a shorter lunge.
Only tumbles in within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to tumble in. Off: it only tumbles when the target is already in reach.
On: only used while you carry no item, to take the doubled tumble. Off: it also fills in as a plain Flying strike while carrying something.
